description: Every manual change applied on top of the automated pipeline. Each entry records the target, the original value, the corrected value, the kind of correction, the evidence, a confidence level, the reason and the date. The world builder refuses entries that lack any of these fields.

overrides.corrected: Stylised red sculpture (three curved blades, about 11 blocks tall) on a low two-step round plinth, generated at the OpenStreetMap artwork node for the Red Bird sundial in the centre of the Piazza roundabout.
overrides.evidence: Aerial Photograph from Lands Department, HKSAR Government (Imagery Map API, viewed 2026-11-11 as a private reference; not redistributed); photographs on https://hkust.edu.hk/
overrides.reason: The sculpture is a point in OSM, not geometry. Its form is an interpretation of the photograph on the official HKUST website; size and orientation are not surveyed.

overrides.original: OpenStreetMap maps only the roundabout carriageway; the island inside it has no land cover, so the build rendered it as grass with trees and drew the carriageway as asphalt between grass verges.
overrides.evidence: Aerial Photograph from Lands Department, HKSAR Government (Imagery Map API, viewed 2026-11-11 as a private reference; not redistributed); photographs on https://hkust.edu.hk/
overrides.reason: The Red Bird sundial stands in the open on a paved circular island; the roundabout is part of the paved Piazza, with no lawn and no trees around the sundial. The island, the carriageway and its kerb are therefore given the Piazza's paving and kept free of trees.

overrides.original: No trees on the Piazza (plazas are tree-free by rule).
overrides.evidence: Aerial Photograph from Lands Department, HKSAR Government (Imagery Map API, viewed 2026-11-11 as a private reference; not redistributed); photographs on https://hkust.edu.hk/
overrides.reason: The Piazza has small trees in planters set out in arcs concentric with the sundial. Their number, radii and exact positions here are approximate: two arcs of small trees are generated by rule, not surveyed.

overrides.original: leisure=park "LG7 Lawn Area": one OpenStreetMap polygon about 320 m long that also takes in the staff quarters and the wooded slopes east of the Academic Building; the build rendered all of it as open lawn with a few ornamental trees.
overrides.evidence: Aerial Photograph from Lands Department, HKSAR Government (Imagery Map API, viewed 2026-11-11 as a private reference; not redistributed)
overrides.reason: Only one plot inside the polygon is open lawn; the rest is under tree canopy. The polygon is therefore treated as woodland, except for the lawn plot, whose outline was estimated by eye from the aerial photograph (about ±5 m) and is approximate.
